objective: Complete the NACA 0012 ladders on the TMR-distributed grids: 225x65 and 449x129 at alpha 10, then full ladders at alpha 0 and 15, with observed order and Richardson values against the published finest-grid results
rationale: Steady solves sustain a wake-driven oscillation on these grids; a 75-minute time-accurate round showed a cold start stays effectively laminar for far longer than an affordable window and a steady-field seed destabilizes the march at any step tried. The case needs a long time-accurate run (hundreds of convective units) or a ramped restart strategy, budgeted as hours, not minutes
citations: NASA Langley Turbulence Modeling Resource: NACA 0012 validation case and distributed grids (turbmodels.larc.nasa.gov)
expected_knowledge_gain: First lifting-body ladder; whether the verification discipline holds when pressure drag and lift dominate
launch_prompt: Resolve the NACA 0012 coarse-rung state honestly: run pimpleFoam on the 113x33 TMR grid from the cold start for at least 300 convective units (detached, polled), watching transition onset via y+ and Cd; if a limit cycle emerges, average over 10 periods with the envelope; if the flow stays steady, report that the steady-solver oscillation is a pseudo-time artifact and quote the steady state instead. Only then extend up the ladder. Start from demo-output/website/tmr/naca0012_status.json and honor the STOP file.
